title: Legacy Serial F
text: Send and receive data over mainboard baseboard serial port with FIFO, 1 input, 1 output, {Parity} sets Parity for checking data transfer; {Serial port} sets the port that is being accessed Legacy Serial, {Baud rate} sets the baud for transferring data, {Data bits} sets the number of bits per character, {Stop bits} sets the number of stop bits for port, {Enable auto RTS/CTS} enables RTS/CTS handshake, {Port to modify} sets the port that is being accessed, {Receive FIFO size} sets the fIFO size in bytes, {Transmit data type} sets the data type of transmitter count+32 and {Sample Time}. Values come from the instance.
